rationale: No existing spec covers the AI-chat keyboard shortcut gate. status-pages-enterprise-gating.spec.js and edition-features.spec.js are the closest analogs (edition-gated UI assertions) but both target their own features, not the Ctrl+B AI-chat binding or the menu-link-ai-item header button. logstable.spec.js only matched the keyword 'shortcut' incidentally. This is a distinct feature area (global layout keyboard gate), so a new GeneralTests spec is warranted and must be registered in ci_matrix.json under the GeneralTests run_files.
